title: Record number of UFO sightings in 2020

tellings.quote: These things are seen in in times of greater social breakdown. And so there's actually a record number of sightings in 2020.

plain: In 2020, more people in the United States reported seeing UFOs than in any year before. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in a 2022 conversation with the economist Tyler Cowen. He ties the claim to a broader idea: that sightings come in times when society is breaking down, so a troubled year like 2020 would bring a record number of them.
